user.title: Which heating system?
user.description: Choose the manufacturer. Bosch / Buderus is connected via the EMS-ESP gateway, Samsung EHS via the HACS integration EHS Sentinel.

menu_options.bsb: BSB adapter (ESP/BSB-Atom or BSB-LAN) – Brötje, Elco, Baxi …

bosch.title: Connect EMS-ESP
bosch.description: IP address (or hostname) of the EMS-ESP and a user with admin rights. Factory default: admin / admin.

data_description.username: User must be admin (needed for firmware update and restart)

samsung.title: Samsung EHS
samsung.description:
The values come from the HACS integration **EHS Sentinel** (RS485 adapter on the heat pump). The manager adds the panel “Samsung EHS” in the sidebar, the EHS Sentinel log and the Heizstab control.

{found}

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate EMS-ESP
reauth_confirm.description: The login to EMS-ESP is no longer valid. Please enter the credentials again.

heater.title: Heizstab (novolto)

data.host: Web address of the heating rod (optional)

data_description.topic: Default: serial number (setting mqtt.base_topic in the device). Overrides the selection.
data_description.lan: Checks all devices in Home Assistant's network for a web configuration (port 80) and Modbus (port 502) and detects the novolto heating rod. Takes a few seconds.
data_description.host: IP of the start page, e.g. 192.168.0.17 (router device list). With “Search again” only this address is checked; the integration then links the start page and the expert page.

heater_confirm.title: Heizstab found
heater_confirm.description: novolto heating rod **{serial}** (firmware {fw}, topic `{topic}`) was found on the MQTT broker. Add it? Control (PV surplus, fixed power) is set up in the panel “Heizstab”.

bsb.title: BSB adapter

data_description.lan: Checks all devices with a web page (port 80) for the BSB-LAN JSON API (/JI).

bsb_confirm.title: BSB adapter found
bsb_confirm.description:
**{name}** ({kind}) was detected as BSB adapter. Direct query on the bus: {get}.

Add it? The controller is detected automatically afterwards.
